title: Linus Interest Accounts begin operating
description: Linus Financial began offering interest-bearing accounts to U.S. investors, accepting dollars and converting them into USDC for pooled deployment through DeFi liquidity pools and institutional lending.
notes: The SEC order identifies 19 March 2020 as the approximate start date.

title: Linus stops accepting new investors
description: Linus voluntarily ceased offering new Linus Interest Accounts and instructed existing customers to withdraw their funds by 22 April 2022.
notes: The action followed the SEC's BlockFi settlement and communications with SEC staff.

title: Linus Interest Accounts cease operations
description: Linus stopped paying interest on remaining account balances and ended the public interest-account product after asking customers to withdraw.
notes: The SEC order states that all investor funds were subsequently claimed.

title: SEC confirms all investor funds were claimed
description: The SEC's settled order stated that all investor funds from the Linus Interest Accounts had been claimed following the 2022 wind-down.
notes: The exact date of the final customer withdrawal is not stated; this event uses the order date as the date the completed outcome was formally confirmed.

title: SEC enters cease-and-desist order against Linus Financial
description: The SEC settled charges that Linus Financial offered and sold the Linus Interest Accounts without registration, while declining to impose a civil penalty because of cooperation and prompt remedial action.
notes: Linus consented to the order without admitting or denying the findings, apart from jurisdiction and subject matter.
